elements.texte:
[cheerful] The internal catalog is the products table.

Karim, the developer, added the box underscore selection column to it.

A checked product is worth 1: it’s part of the selection.

Your turn!

Three products are selected: the tea, the protein and the shaker.

The agency only needs their name, their category and their price.

The stock levels and the other products must stay internal.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] Your mission: create the view box underscore catalog.

CREATE VIEW creates a view, here named box underscore catalog.

As introduces the query the view stores.

Your turn!

Select picks the columns: the name, the category and the price.

Where box underscore selection equals 1 keeps only the products in the selection.

A view stores a query under a name.

Here, it shows only the columns and products needed to prepare the box.

Click the “Create the view” button.

The box underscore catalog view is stored in the database.
